items.text: changed: The let-go counter is now just a small yellow number (no pill) that fades in lightly, with no scaling.

When the device is too full and a sound has to be let go, a small yellow counter appears at the top left of the load meter and pulses each time it happens. It is no longer reported as a failure. Tap the counter to copy or email the report, or to clear the count.
The four "how much each roll changes" stops (inverse golden, half, golden, all) carry small share diagrams, with the golden spiral arc on the two golden ones.
Press and hold the robot to open the heads-up display at the play lines (the ways the lines run), scrolled into view. A tap still starts and stops the robot.

A held note keeps its halo going for as long as it sounds. Before, only some held sounds kept pulsing (the ones that repeat); a held arrow, a big square or a synth note showed its halo once, when tapped, and then it faded though the note played on. Now every held note sends out a new halo about every second.

A held note answers to the cursor whatever hand or tool is chosen. In touch mode or with the pencil, press and drag on a held note to shape it (up and down is volume, left and right is reverb), or tap it to let it go. Before, this only worked with the closed hand on, so it seemed broken.

Ghosts. When the load ceiling lets go of a held sound, the note stays held but silent: it is drawn hollow with a still dashed ring and the status line says so. When there is room again (a second and a half later, and a little headroom) it sounds again. A held note no longer dies without a sign.

Turning the hand (Hold) off, or switching to the pencil, no longer ends the notes you are holding. They keep sounding until you let them go: the cross button under the hand now shows whenever any note is held and the hand is off (and when two or more are held with it on), and Escape still lets go of all.
Held notes keep playing when you stop the lines (the robot). They are your hand's notes, not the lines', so only you, Escape, or a change of mode lets them go.
When two or more notes are held, a round cross button appears under the hand button. It lets go of all of them at once.
